mapper.select: SELECT id, generation_job_id, user_id, reserved_credits, actual_credits, receivable_credits, status, allocations, catalog_version, discount_bp, rule_snapshot, title, release_note, gmt_create, gmt_modified, version FROM billing_cost_reservations WHERE generation_job_id = #{jobId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_cost_reservations SET status = 'refunded', release_note = LEFT(#{releaseNote}, 255), version = version + 1 WHERE generation_job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, COALESCE(SUM(reserved_credits), 0) AS amount FROM billing_cost_reservations WHERE user_id IN #{uid} AND status = 'charged' GROUP BY user_id
